mechanism: every record unpacked and replayed from (trail,step) alone: coefficient pair reconstructed by re-running the deterministic schedule; collision da,db gives x=-da/db, verified by cand*P==Q
replay_cost: two dependent trails re-run to their hit step; each replayed step pays the FULL extended-Euclid inversion (no 2^20 batch amortisation), priced in ledger_v16 replay_relative_loss
